newsitem.title: FRANCE: SocGen to spin off portfolio activities.
newsitem.headline: SocGen to spin off portfolio activities.

text.p: French bank Societe Generale said on Thursday it would spin off its portfolio management activities into subsidiaries as of January 1, 1997 to develop its operations especially abroad.
This move is "aimed at developing our portfolio activities, notably internationally, by making them more independent," the bank said.
It said that the action followed a French law updating financial activities passed in July 1996.

"Portfolio management was already independent from the bank but this move demonstrates that there is a real 'Chinese' wall between the portfolio management activities and the activities of the bank," said a bank spokesman.
He said it would be the first major French bank to transform its portfolio management activities into subsidiaries and followed the lead of banks in the United States and other countries.
